headline: IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving upside for some firms while others trimmed guidance.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI‑led contracts were a common theme, boosting profit margins at HCLTech and Mphasis. Margin guidance was raised by Coforge but trimmed by Infosys. Profit trends were mixed, with Wipro and Infosys seeing modest gains and Wipro a slight decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven deal conversion
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI‑led contracts as a key growth driver, lifting profit margins and pipeline quality.

themes.title: Margin guidance divergence
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin outlook, while Infosys cut its revenue growth guidance, reflecting differing confidence levels.

themes.title: Modest constant‑currency growth
themes.detail: Most large players reported low constant‑currency revenue growth, indicating a challenging macro environment.
